title: Garmin Brings Voice Control to Your Handlebars with the New Edge 1060
content:
Garmin just overhauled its cycling lineup with three major releases: the microphone-equipped Edge 1060, the touch-friendly Explore 3 series, and a new indoor smart trainer that brings built-in motion to a more accessible price point.

Read the full article at Garmin Brings Voice Control to Your Handlebars with the New Edge 1060 on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
